en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large rectangular castle-like building with a round tower on the left and a clock or bell tower with a spire rising from the roof near the center. The foreground contains a park with paths, trees, and a street where several horse-drawn carriages are visible. Printed text at the top right identifies the subject in Russian and German.
